Hymn 22: We Listen to a Prophet's Voice
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Darwin K. Wolford
Lyricist/Text Author: Marylou Cunningham Leavitt
Category: Restoration

This is hymn number 22 titled "We Listen to a Prophet's Voice" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Darwin K. Wolford and the lyrics were written by Marylou Cunningham Leavitt.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
